candidate.title: FRISCR
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina schematic of FRISCR (Fixed and Recovered Intact Single Cell RNA): fixed, stained, individually sorted cells → recovered polyadenylated mRNA → template-switched cDNA/PCR → Nextera XT tagmentation and indexed Illumina fragment. Smart-seq2 and Nextera XT are embedded preparation components, not additional target workflows. The leftmost fixed-cell-to-RNA vignette is an overview, not an alternative branch; no material pooling or alternative route is depicted. This is the illustrated fixed-cell implementation, not the paper's live-cell controls, population RNA isolation experiments, or every possible FRISCR application.

states.label: Template-switched, adapter-bearing cDNA synthesis intermediate
features: The cDNA synthesis region shows a paired structure with GGG/CCC at the left end, AAAAAA/TTTTTT at the right, and terminal colored adapter segments.

The flanking sequences provide an amplification interface for transcript-derived cDNA.

states.label: Enrichment-ready indexed cDNA library fragment
features: The final drawing labels P5 at the left end, Index 2 near that end, Index 1 near the right end, and P7 at the right end.
Transcript-derived DNA insert flanked by Illumina adapter/index interfaces, after gap repair and PCR.

Sequencing these fragments supports per-cell transcript detection and relative expression profiles. Per-cell provenance originates in separately sorted reactions; the indexes identify libraries for sequencing.
The visible Index 1/Index 2 labels do not establish unique original-RNA molecule tagging or absolute molecule counts.

Full-length transcriptome profiling refers to coverage along transcripts by library fragments; the primary implementation uses short paired-end reads and reports 3′ bias, especially for longer transcripts.

operations.information_effect: Enables fixed-cell marker-based selection; RNA must subsequently be recovered from the fixation-associated state.

operations.label: Isolate RNA
operations.description: Recover polyadenylated mRNA from the reverse-crosslinked single-cell lysate. Capture and elution are components of this one drawn isolation block.
operations.mechanism: Oligo dT25 magnetic-bead hybridization to poly(A), followed by mRNA elution into supernatant and transfer; the beads are capture reagents, not the final template support.
operations.information_effect: Enriches polyadenylated RNA and removes it from the reverse-crosslinking mixture. Recovery is selective and does not establish detection of all transcripts.
